docs.title: Local firm goes green
docs.text: PORTVILLE — Lindqvist Printing, one of Portville's oldest businesses, has completed the installation of 600 solar panels on the roof of its factory. The panels are expected to provide about 40 percent of the company's electricity. "Our customers increasingly ask about the environmental impact of their orders," said owner Erik Lindqvist. Lindqvist Printing was founded in 1962 by Mr. Lindqvist's grandfather and now employs 85 people.
